summary.text: Josh Steinhoff is the Republican candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Shawn Olorundami; he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Steinhoff also ran for the same seat in 2024, when incumbent J.D. Scholten defeated him in the general election.
